title: server.create (platform → host)
description: Provisions the next server-N (csm's add-server flow: copy of the master install, configs, next ports +10) and starts it. With enroll: true csm writes game/csgo/cfg/ReadyUp/fleet.cfg (url + enroll_key, mode 0600) before the start so Ready Up self-enrolls (FLEET.md §4.1 B); the key is enroll_key when given, else the fleet key the host was linked with (rejected no_enroll_key when there is neither). Long job: host.progress while it runs. The host.result output names the new servers. Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id). Rejected with `expired` when expires_at is past, and with `stale` when the envelope ts is more than 5 min off the host's clock (a command replayed long after it was sent is not run).

name_prefix.description: csm always names servers server-N: anything but "server-" is rejected unsupported

game_port.description: csm spaces servers 10 ports apart: anything but the next port (with count 1) is rejected unsupported

enroll_key.description: csm addition: the fleet key to hand to the new servers

accept_license.description: csm addition: the Ready Up license use the platform's admin accepted (Settings > License). csm saves it as the host's answer when the host has none of its own (an operator's `csm plugins license` or AT_ACCEPT_LICENSE always wins), so unattended Ready Up installs can run.
